data.name: Mourning Tide
data.detailed_description:
Have you heard the legend of the mourning fisherman? A tale told in hushed whispers and furtive glances. Of a man, burdened by regrets too heavy for the shore, who sailed into waters where men dare not to go. Did he seek peace? Redemption? Pray not. For the sea gives neither.

A Sea of Terrors

You are the fisherman, adrift for time unknown in a place where the bustle of port is but a distant memory. Out here it’s just you, the fish, and your memories. Cast your line. Wait for a bite. Pull hard. But this place is not as it seems. And the tides never forget.

A Unique Fishing Experience

More than your simple fishing minigame. Mourning Tide features a unique system that rewards your skill and evolves as you progress. Each fish behaves differently and requires quick thinking to overcome.

Nightmares From the Depths

Uncover increasingly horrifying creatures with each catch. You never know what you might pull out of the sea.

Game Features

  • Atmosphere & PSX-style Graphics - Immerse yourself in a hauntingly nostalgic world with PSX-inspired visuals

  • Fishing Mechanics - Cast your line into the dark waters, where the sea tests your coordination while pulling you deeper into madness.

  • Gripping Story - Unravel a tragic tale of guilt and loss, where the past is never far behind and the sea holds secrets that may never let you go.

  • An Entirely New Experience of Mourning Tide - Featuring 1 hour of gameplay.

data.short_description: A guilt-ridden fisherman sails into forbidden waters. With every catch, the echoes of his life rise to the surface. Unravel the past, seek redemption’s light, or be consumed by the Mourning Tide. A fishing horror game.

content_descriptors.notes: Mourning Tide contains mature themes, including psychological trauma, emotional abuse, gore, violence, and depictions of grief and self-destructive behavior. The story explores a fisherman’s internal struggles, including moments of despair and a loss of identity. The game features intense emotional situations, references to suicide, murder and scenes that may be disturbing to sensitive players. Player discretion is advised.
